TinyLLM-System.descZh: 基于 PyTorch FSDP2 与 Qwen3 的可复现 LLM 后训练、评测与服务系统。
TinyLLM-System.descEn: A reproducible LLM post-training, evaluation, and serving system built with PyTorch FSDP2 and Qwen3.

zh.background: 将后训练、评测和推理服务拆成可重复运行的工程流程，便于验证不同训练与服务策略。
zh.outcome: 形成覆盖训练、评测和服务的实验型 LLM 工程基线。

en.background: A reproducible workflow for post-training, evaluation, and serving experiments.
en.outcome: Provides an engineering baseline that connects training, evaluation, and serving.

commerceflow-agent.descZh: 面向电商流程的智能体实验项目。
commerceflow-agent.descEn: An agent-based experiment for commerce workflows.

zh.background: 探索智能体在电商流程中的任务拆解、工具调用与结果编排。
zh.outcome: 沉淀了面向业务流程的智能体实验代码与设计思路。

en.background: Explores task decomposition, tool use, and orchestration for commerce workflows.
en.outcome: Captures reusable agent experiments and design patterns for business workflows.

LifeSideQuest.descZh: 基于 Flutter 的人生支线任务 APP，帮助完成每天的支线任务。
LifeSideQuest.descEn: A Flutter app for completing daily life side quests.

zh.background: 把日常目标转化为更轻量、更有趣的支线任务体验。
zh.outcome: 完成了一个面向移动端的任务管理与激励原型。

en.background: Turns everyday goals into a lighter and more playful side-quest experience.
en.outcome: A mobile task-management and motivation prototype built with Flutter.

zh.background: 整理个人常用的开发、学习和 AI 资源，降低重复查找成本。
zh.outcome: 上线了可持续维护的个人资源导航站。

en.background: Organizes frequently used development, learning, and AI resources.
en.outcome: A maintainable personal resource navigation site published online.

LingStack.descZh: 基于 Flutter 和 Go 的跨端 AI 资源库，收集 Prompts、Skills 与 MCP。
LingStack.descEn: A cross-platform AI resource library built with Flutter and Go for Prompts, Skills, and MCP.

zh.background: 为快速增长的 AI 工具与资源建立统一的整理、检索和跨端使用入口。
zh.outcome: 搭建了覆盖移动端与服务端的 AI 资源库雏形。

en.background: Creates a unified way to organize, search, and use the growing set of AI resources.
en.outcome: A cross-platform AI resource library prototype spanning client and server.

zh.background: 用博客记录 AI 工程、开发实践和个人项目，并保持内容可检索、可复现。
zh.outcome: 构建了支持中英文、项目展示和技术文章的个人站点。

en.background: Documents AI engineering, development practices, and personal projects in a searchable format.
en.outcome: A bilingual personal site for projects and technical writing.

ArxivChef.descZh: 抓取对应研究方向的 arXiv 最新论文。
ArxivChef.descEn: A script to fetch the latest arXiv papers for specific research areas.

zh.background: 减少跟踪研究方向新论文时的重复检索和筛选工作。
zh.outcome: 提供了按研究方向获取 arXiv 最新论文的自动化工具。

en.background: Reduces repetitive searching and filtering when following new papers.
en.outcome: An automation tool for collecting recent arXiv papers by research area.
